from pathlib import Path
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    positions = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v != bg:
                positions.setdefault(v, []).append((r, c))
    centers = [(sum(r for r,c in ps)/len(ps), sum(c for r,c in ps)/len(ps)) for ps in positions.values()]
    cr = sum(r for r,c in centers)/len(centers)
    cc = sum(c for r,c in centers)/len(centers)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color, ps in positions.items():
        if len(ps) < 2:
            continue
        pr = sum(r for r,c in ps)/len(ps)
        pc = sum(c for r,c in ps)/len(ps)
        dr = 1 if pr > cr else -1
        dc = 1 if pc > cc else -1
        r, c = max(ps, key=lambda p: (p[0]-pr)*dr + (p[1]-pc)*dc)
        while 0 <= r+dr < h and 0 <= c+dc < w:
            r += dr; c += dc
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text(code)
print(p)
